headline_seed: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules - BBC
draft_text:
The UN's top court ruled Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya — the first time the ICJ has found a state responsible for genocide, per AP and Axios.

Al Jazeera reports 730,000 Rohingya fled to Bangladesh after the 2017 crackdown.

And that's the mews.
